author: Impresses
body:
I'm here to Report the user "ImRaging". I would like to first state he hates me.

So, I was on the server, I say "lmao" - WARNING
I use some caps like "DUDE THAT ISNT WRITE" - Warning
ETC, ETC.

Then somebody calls me a cunt, and i call them a cunt back. Then 2-3 minutes later, I get kicked. BUT When I joined back and scrolled up, I could still see the other guys message. But when Raging scrolled up, before he kicked me, he couldn't see it. Strange?
Also, 3 other staff were on whilst I was saying lmao. None of them warned or kicked me, only Raging.

I can't provide proof since I don't take screenies, and I'm banned.
